title: Flaky: plugin-security org-admin-assignment-boundary posture test times out at 5000 ms on a loaded CI runner
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbXGvw43spR79ztEvWt

## What

`@objectstack/plugin-security` `src/org-admin-assignment-boundary.posture.test.ts`, test "[ADR-0090 D12, amended 2026-10-17] the three-officer split: an auditor set carrying a platform-scoped capability is outside the organization boundary", failed on a PR head with `Error: Test timed out in 5000ms.` and passed on the re-run of the same head.

- PR #35085, head `1878e86b9dece34ce9f934b7de5217d46977ecc0`, `Test Core (8/10)`, run 44229929988 attempt 1 (job 134552934766): timeout. Attempt 2 of the same run: green (71 check-runs, 62 success, 9 expected skips).
- The PR's changed files are outside the test's import closure (`core`, `metadata-protocol`, `objectql`, `spec/security`, `driver-sql`, `types`, `platform-objects`, local plugin-security files). The five latest `ci.yml` push runs on `main` at the time had green Test Core.
- The log also carries an `Acquire connection error: Error: aborted` warning from the same shard, consistent with a loaded runner. The test boots a kernel with the SQL driver under the default 5000 ms per-test timeout.
- Seat read on the PR: comment 6968590259.

## Expected

The test passes deterministically: either its setup moves out of the per-test budget (a `beforeAll` boot) or it carries an explicit timeout sized to the kernel boot, decided by whoever fixes it from a measured boot time.

## Re-check

`grep -n "three-officer split" packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/org-admin-assignment-boundary.posture.test.ts` (positive control in the same file: `describe(`).
